7 files, summaries:

**graph/__init__.py** — empty.

**graph/ingest.py** — repo-to-graph walker. `walk_repo` lists files minus skip dirs (`.git`, `node_modules`, etc), `find_nested_projects` excludes vendored subrepos. `ModuleExtractor(ast.NodeVisitor)` pulls nodes/edges from one module (imports, classes, functions, calls). `ingest_repo` drives full pipeline: hash-based skip of unchanged files, two-pass resolve (definitions collected first, edges resolved second via `_resolve`), then `_drop_orphan_externals` and `_link_tests`. Python-only scope, unresolved calls kept not dropped.

**graph/query.py** — read-only graph queries via `GraphQuery` class. `define`/`exists` for symbol lookup, `callers`/`callees`/`tests_for` for relationships, `untested` (over-approximating, has `untested_caveat()`), `import_cycles`, `unresolved_calls`, `file_dependencies`. Centerpiece is `context_for`: BM25 seed match + graph-hop expansion (decay 0.4/hop) to surface task-relevant code by relationship, not just text match. `render_relevant` formats output.

**graph/store.py** — `GraphStore`: SQLite-backed persistence for nodes/edges/files tables (chosen over Neo4j/networkx for zero-dependency simplicity). Write ops `add_nodes`/`add_edges`/`forget_file`/`record_file`. Read ops `get_node`/`nodes_named`/`search_nodes`/`all_nodes`/`edges_from`/`edges_to`/`unresolved_edges`. Traversal: `neighbours` (1-hop), `reachable` (bounded BFS), `cycles` (iterative DFS cycle detection over imports). `stats()` for counts.

**consistency/__init__.py** — empty.

**consistency/check.py** — checks agent claims against graph/memory, no model calls. `check_symbol_exists`, `check_symbol_relation` (dispatches to `check_file_imports`, `check_symbol_calls_file`, `_check_defined_relation`), `check_file_exists` verify claims against `GraphQuery`; ambiguous/unresolved always `UNVERIFIABLE`, never guessed. `check_decision_resurfacing`/`check_constraint_violations` do BM25 lexical-overlap against `MemoryStore` decisions/constraints (self-normalized score, capped confidence 0.85). `run_consistency_check` orchestrates, `render_report` formats.

**consistency/claims.py** — extracts checkable claims from agent text, deterministically. Only fires on backtick-quoted spans + closed set of relation phrases (`calls`, `inherits from`, `extends`, `imports`, plus negated forms) — never guesses at free prose. `extract_claims` main entry, emits `SYMBOL_RELATION`/`SYMBOL_EXISTS`/`FILE_EXISTS` claims. Helpers: `looks_like_path`, `looks_like_bare_name`, `_looks_like_symbol`, `_extra_targets` (handles "`X` calls `Y` and `Z`").
